text: uppajjati sukhā vedanā . saṃvijjati kho gahapati jivhādhātu rasā ca amanāpā jivhāviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā . saṃvijjati kho gahapati jivhādhātu rasā ca upekkhaṭṭhāniyā jivhāviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā .pe. saṃvijjati kho gahapati manodhātu dhammā ca manāpā manoviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhā vedanā . saṃvijjati kho gahapati manodhātu dhammā ca amanāpā manoviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā . saṃvijjati kho
